Sentiments have two main components: subjectivity & objectivity
Subjective Sentiments - These refer back towards personal feelings rather than facts e.g., “I love this movie” vs.”This film was terrible”
Objective sentiments- This type focuses less around individual emotions but instead looks at general trends within groups i.e.:“Most viewers enjoyed watching Avengers Endgame.”
There’s also another category called neutral where neither side holds strong views either way (“It wasn’t great nor bad”). Neutral doesn’t mean no emotion though because sometimes even when someone says they don’t care much about certain things still shows signs indicating otherwise through body language cues during conversations with friends/family members who know better!
